name: INTELLEX HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd.
summary: Intellex Holdings Co., Ltd. manages and administers group companies in real estate sales, consulting and leasing. Its Renovation segment, the core business, purchases pre-owned condominiums one by one in major cities and resells them, while the Solutions segment covers developing, selling, renting, managing and brokering other real estate. It has its headquarters in Shibuya-ku, Japan.
